name: TabTools
summary: Clear your tab list quickly and keep your browser tidy.
description:
Too many tabs? TabTools helps you close unwanted tabs, remove duplicates and organise your browser in seconds.

⚡ QUICK TAB CLEANUP
• Right-click shortcuts — close tabs from the current site through the context menu.
• Close by keyword or domain — target the tabs you want to clear.
• Site suggestions — see which sites have the most open tabs and close them together.
• Close inactive tabs — choose how long a tab can be inactive before it qualifies for cleanup.

🗂️ KEEP YOUR BROWSER ORGANISED
• Sort by site frequency — group tabs by site, ordered by how many you have open.
• Remove duplicate tabs — clear repeated tabs in one click.
• Light and dark themes — choose the look you prefer.
• Local statistics — see how many tabs you have closed with TabTools.

🔒 PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Tab Tools does not collect or transmit personal data. Your settings and statistics stay stored locally in your browser.
